Step 1: 1599 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Step 2: Days from 04-28 to end of April: 3 days (29, 30 → 2 days? Wait: April has 30 days, so 28 → 29 (1), 29 → 30 (2) → 2 days left in April). Correction: 30 - 28 = 2 days left.  
Step 3: Add 183 days:  
- April: 2 days (April 29–30) → 181 days left.  
- May (31): 181 - 31 = 150 left.  
- June (30): 150 - 30 = 120 left.  
- July (31): 120 - 31 = 89 left.  
- August (31): 89 - 31 = 58 left.  
- September (30): 58 - 30 = 28 left.  
- October has 31 days, so 28 days into October = October 28.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1599-10-28
